95 // Class basic_string_base.
96
97 // basic_string_base is a helper class that makes it it easier to write
98 // an exception-safe version of basic_string. The constructor allocates,
99 // but does not initialize, a block of memory. The destructor
100 // deallocates, but does not destroy elements within, a block of
101 // memory. The destructor assumes that the memory either is the internal buffer,
102 // or else points to a block of memory that was allocated using string_base's
103 // allocator and whose size is this->m_storage.
104 template <class Allocator, class Options>
105 class basic_string_base

574 //! The basic_string class represents a Sequence of characters. It contains all the
575 //! usual operations of a Sequence, and, additionally, it contains standard string
576 //! operations such as search and concatenation.
577 //!
578 //! The basic_string class is parameterized by character type, and by that type's
579 //! Character Traits.
580 //!
581 //! This class has performance characteristics very much like vector<>, meaning,
582 //! for example, that it does not perform reference-count or copy-on-write, and that
583 //! concatenation of two strings is an O(N) operation.
584 //!
585 //! Some of basic_string's member functions use an unusual method of specifying positions
586 //! and ranges. In addition to the conventional method using iterators, many of
587 //! basic_string's member functions use a single value pos of type size_type to represent a
588 //! position (in which case the position is begin() + pos, and many of basic_string's
589 //! member functions use two values, pos and n, to represent a range. In that case pos is
590 //! the beginning of the range and n is its size. That is, the range is
591 //! [begin() + pos, begin() + pos + n).
592 //!
593 //! Note that the C++ standard does not specify the complexity of basic_string operations.
594 //! In this implementation, basic_string has performance characteristics very similar to
595 //! those of vector: access to a single character is O(1), while copy and concatenation
596 //! are O(N).
597 //!
598 //! In this implementation, begin(),
599 //! end(), rbegin(), rend(), operator[], c_str(), and data() do not invalidate iterators.
600 //! In this implementation, iterators are only invalidated by member functions that
601 //! explicitly change the string's contents.
602 //!
603 //! \tparam CharT The type of character it contains.
604 //! \tparam Traits The Character Traits type, which encapsulates basic character operations
605 //! \tparam Allocator The allocator, used for internal memory management.
606 //! \tparam Options A type produced from \c boost::container::string_options.
607 #ifdef BOOST_CONTAINER_DOXYGEN_INVOKED

3712
3713 9x for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
3714 7x ok = ok && !Traits::eq_int_type(buf->sputc(f), Traits::eof());

3721 template <class CharT, class Traits, class Allocator, class Options>
3722 std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits>&
3723 2x operator<<(std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits>& os, const basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>& s)
3724 {
3725 2x typename std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits>::sentry sentry(os);
3726 2x bool ok = false;
3727
3728 2x if (sentry) {
3729 2x ok = true;
3730 2x typename basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>::size_type n = s.size();
3731 2x typename basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>::size_type pad_len = 0;
3732 2x const bool left = (os.flags() & std::ios::left) != 0;
3733 2x const std::size_t w = static_cast<std::size_t>(os.width(0));
3734 2x std::basic_streambuf<CharT, Traits>* buf = os.rdbuf();
3735
3736 2x if (w != 0 && n < w)
3737 1x pad_len = w - n;
3738
3739 2x if (!left)
3740 1x ok = dtl::string_fill(os, buf, pad_len);
3741
3742 4x ok = ok &&
3743 2x buf->sputn(s.data(), std::streamsize(n)) == std::streamsize(n);
3744
3745 2x if (left)
3746 1x ok = ok && dtl::string_fill(os, buf, pad_len);
3747 }
3748
3749 2x if (!ok)
3750 ✗ os.setstate(std::ios_base::failbit);
3751
3752 2x return os;
3753 2x }

3756 template <class CharT, class Traits, class Allocator, class Options>
3757 std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>&
3758 3x operator>>(std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>& is, basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>& s)
3759 {
3760 3x typename std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>::sentry sentry(is);
3761
3762 3x if (sentry) {
3763 2x std::basic_streambuf<CharT, Traits>* buf = is.rdbuf();
3764 2x const std::ctype<CharT>& ctype = std::use_facet<std::ctype<CharT> >(is.getloc());
3765
3766 2x s.clear();
3767 2x std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(is.width(0));
3768 2x if (n == 0)
3769 2x n = static_cast<std::size_t>(-1);
3770 else
3771 ✗ s.reserve(n);
3772
3773 12x while (n-- > 0) {
3774 12x typename Traits::int_type c1 = buf->sbumpc();
3775
3776 12x if (Traits::eq_int_type(c1, Traits::eof())) {
3777 1x is.setstate(std::ios_base::eofbit);
3778 2x break;
3779 }
3780 else {
3781 11x CharT c = Traits::to_char_type(c1);
3782
3783 11x if (ctype.is(std::ctype<CharT>::space, c)) {
3784 1x if (Traits::eq_int_type(buf->sputbackc(c), Traits::eof()))
3785 ✗ is.setstate(std::ios_base::failbit);
3786 1x break;
3787 }
3788 else
3789 10x s.push_back(c);
3790 }
3791 }
3792
3793 // If we have read no characters, then set failbit.
3794 2x if (s.size() == 0)
3795 ✗ is.setstate(std::ios_base::failbit);
3796 }
3797 else
3798 1x is.setstate(std::ios_base::failbit);
3799
3800 3x return is;
3801 }

3803 template <class CharT, class Traits, class Allocator, class Options>
3804 std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>&
3805 getline(std::istream& is, basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>& s,CharT delim)
3806 {
3807 typename basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>::size_type nread = 0;
3808 typename std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>::sentry sentry(is, true);
3809 if (sentry) {
3810 std::basic_streambuf<CharT, Traits>* buf = is.rdbuf();
3811 s.clear();
3812
3813 while (nread < s.max_size()) {
3814 int c1 = buf->sbumpc();
3815 if (Traits::eq_int_type(c1, Traits::eof())) {
3816 is.setstate(std::ios_base::eofbit);
3817 break;
3818 }
3819 else {
3820 ++nread;
3821 CharT c = Traits::to_char_type(c1);
3822 if (!Traits::eq(c, delim))
3823 s.push_back(c);
3824 else
3825 break; // Character is extracted but not appended.
3826 }
3827 }
3828 }
3829 if (nread == 0 || nread >= s.max_size())
3830 is.setstate(std::ios_base::failbit);
3831
3832 return is;
3833 }
3834
3835 template <class CharT, class Traits, class Allocator, class Options>
3836 inline std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>&
3837 getline(std::basic_istream<CharT, Traits>& is, basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator,Options>& s)
3838 {
3839 return getline(is, s, '\n');
3840 }

3842 //! <b>Effects</b>: Erases all elements that compare equal to v from the container c.
3843 //!
3844 //! <b>Complexity</b>: Linear.
3845 template <class T, class Tr, class A, class U>
3846 inline typename basic_string<T, Tr, A>::size_type erase(basic_string<T, Tr, A>& c, const U& v)
3847 {
3848 typename basic_string<T, Tr, A>::size_type old_size = c.size();
3849 c.erase(boost::container::remove(c.begin(), c.end(), v), c.end());
3850 return old_size - c.size();
3851 }
3852
3853 //! <b>Effects</b>: Erases all elements that satisfy the predicate pred from the container c.
3854 //!
3855 //! <b>Complexity</b>: Linear.
3856 template <class T, class Tr, class A, class Pred>
3857 inline typename basic_string<T, Tr, A>::size_type erase_if(basic_string<T, Tr, A>& c, Pred pred)
3858 {
3859 typename basic_string<T, Tr, A>::size_type old_size = c.size();
3860 c.erase(boost::container::remove_if(c.begin(), c.end(), pred), c.end());
3861 return old_size - c.size();
3862 }
